'''Chapter 126''' is titled "Instinct".

==Cover Page==
[[Jango's Dance Paradise]], Vol. 1: "He Wakes".

In a forest on the outskirts of [[Syrup Village]], a gunpowder-smudged [[Jango]] comes to.

==Short Summary==
[[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], [[Nami]], and [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] are freed from [[Galdino|Mr. 3]]'s candelabra, and Nami and Vivi defeat [[Mikita|Miss Valentine]] while Zoro defeats [[Gem|Mr. 5]] with [[Usopp]]'s help. Meanwhile, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Karoo]] chase Mr. 3 into the woods, where Mr. 3 creates wax duplicates of himself in order to attack Luffy by surprise. However, Luffy immediately manages to attack the real Mr. 3 entirely out of instinct, and Karoo attacks the terrified [[Marianne|Miss Goldenweek]].

Meanwhile, in Mr. 3's house, [[Sanji]] receives a call from the [[Baroque Works]] boss [[Crocodile|Mr. 0]].

==Long Summary==
Thanks to [[Usopp]] and [[Karoo]]'s rope, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] manages to set [[Galdino|Mr. 3]]'s [[Doru Doru no Mi|wax candelabra]] ablaze with the agent's flaming hair. Mr. 3's Candle Champion starts melting as well, and he runs off into the woods with Karoo chasing him. [[Gem|Mr. 5]] and [[Mikita|Miss Valentine]] are left enraged, and Miss Valentine flips up into the air as she prepares to finish off Usopp with a [[Kiro Kiro no Mi|10,000 kilogram axe kick]]. However, [[Nami]] and [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] attack Miss Valentine with their weapons as they emerge from the fire, having been freed by it. Mr. 5 aims [[Flintlock .44 Caliber 6 Shot Revolver|his gun]] at them, and Usopp seemingly shoots an [[Usopp Tactics/Ginga Pachinko|Exploding Star]] at him. Mr. 5 eats it to try to neutralize it, but Usopp reveals that it was actually a hot sauce shot. Mr. 5 struggles to handle the sauce, and decides to kill the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] by [[Bomu Bomu no Mi|blowing himself up]] as he wraps himself around Usopp. However, [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] then emerges from the fire and cuts Mr. 5, defeating him. [[Brogy]], having freed himself from Mr. 3's wax swords being implanted into his hands and feet, then approaches the Straw Hats, noting that there are two enemies yet to be defeated.

Meanwhile, Luffy and Karoo chase after Mr. 3, only to come to a clearing filled with duplicates of the agent. Mr. 3 asks if Luffy knows which of him is real, saying a fighter who relies on instinct like him could not figure it out. As he talks to Luffy, the real Mr. 3 starts sneaking up on him from behind, readying a knife to stab him. However, Luffy immediately kicks the real Mr. 3 in the face, saying he knew which one he was based on instinct. Karoo then spots [[Marianne|Miss Goldenweek]] peeking at the scene from a distant tree, and starts chasing after her to her terror.

At Mr. 3's house, [[Sanji]] realizes he needs to stop drinking tea and resume looking for Nami. However, as he heads out he hears a [[Den Den Mushi]] ringing inside a basket. He answers it, acting like a restaurant. The person on the other end is in no mood for his antics, and thinking Sanji is Mr. 3, asks for a report. Sanji asks who he is, to which the person replies that he is [[Crocodile|Mr. 0]].

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Jango]] wakes up after his defeat by [[Usopp]].
**This is the first chapter of [[Jango's Dance Paradise]].
*The four [[Baroque Works]] agents are defeated.
**[[Mikita|Miss Valentine]] is defeated by [[Nami]] and [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]]'s teamwork before she can crush Usopp to death.
**After Usopp tricks him into consuming spicy sauce, [[Gem|Mr. 5]] is defeated by [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] before an angry Mr. 5 could kill Usopp.
**[[Galdino|Mr. 3]] is defeated by [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] on pure instinct.
**[[Marianne|Miss Goldenweek]] is defeated by [[Karoo]] offscreen.
*[[Sanji]], while inside Mr. 3's wax house, gets a call from [[Crocodile|Mr. 0]].
